data.description:
## Context / Problem

`src/rebar/_lib_ops.py:373` and `src/rebar/_mcp_reads.py:575` retain `reconcile(mode=...)` compatibility even after canonical bridge operations exist. The canonical diagnostic/bridge contract is delivered by nosy-drooly-milksnake [rebar:nosy-drooly-milksnake].

## Approach

Remove the Python and MCP `reconcile(mode=...)` entrypoints and their schemas, examples, baselines, and tests. Replace every repository consumer with explicit `bridge_preview`, `bridge_sync`, or `bridge_run` operations and preserve their result contracts. This is a deliberate pre-1.0 public break.

## Scope

- library/MCP operation definitions and exports
- input/output schemas/baselines, docs/examples, changelog
- static, dynamic, string, and monkeypatch consumers

## Testing

Assert removed APIs reject before reconciliation execution; run each explicit bridge operation through existing result-contract tests.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Python and MCP `reconcile(mode=...)` contracts, schemas, examples, and exports are removed.
- [ ] Every repository consumer calls one explicit canonical bridge operation.
- [ ] Old library/MCP invocations fail at signature/schema validation before work begins.
- [ ] Explicit bridge operations retain their documented result and error contracts.
data.title: Remove reconcile compatibility from Python and MCP contracts
